Card Q&A.q: Can this card’s effect play a [Leomon (X Antibody)] from this Digimon’s digivolution cards?

Effect: [All Turns] When this Digimon would be deleted in battle, you may play 1 [Leomon] from this Digimon’s digivolution cards without paying its memory cost.
